Daily Table per Station

Source: R/monitor_stations.R
monitor_stations.Rd

One row per station and day of the window: pigs, visits, unidentified visits, occupation time, feed intake and body weight.

monitor_stations(
  data,
  days = 7,
  end_date = NULL,
  iqr_k = 1.5,
  station = NULL,
  verbose = 1
)

Arguments

data

Station data: a folder or files of NEDAP or FIRE exports (read with read_station()), a raw export already in R such as tidypptsda::nedap, or the result of read_station() or prep_visits().

days

Number of days in the window, ending on end_date. Default 7.

end_date

Last day of the window (a Date or "YYYY-MM-DD"). Default NULL: the last day in the data, or yesterday when the last day is today (an export taken during the day is incomplete).

iqr_k

Body weights of a pig on a day outside the Tukey fences (quartiles -/+ iqr_k times the interquartile range) are outliers. Default 1.5.

station

"nedap", "fire" or NULL (detect), passed to read_station() and prep_visits().

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

Value

A data.table with one row per station (location) and date, also for days without visits:

  • n_pigs: pigs with at least one identified visit;

  • n_visits: all visits; n_unidentified: visits without a transponder read; pct_unidentified: their percentage;

  • occupation_h: total time the station was occupied, hours;

  • feed_kg: feed intake of all visits, kg; feed_per_pig_kg: feed intake of the identified visits divided by n_pigs;

  • weight_kg: mean over the pigs of their daily median body weight, outliers excluded;

  • pct_weight_outlier: percentage of the recorded body weights that are outliers within the pig and day (see iqr_k).

Counts are 0 and the other columns NA on days without visits.

See also

run_monitor() for all tables at once.

Examples

st <- monitor_stations(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 7, verbose = 0)
st
